howItWorks.title: How it works

steps.title: Send us the drawing
steps.text: Take a photo of the drawing or painting and send it through the form below or on Instagram.

steps.title: We shape it in 3D
steps.text: We turn the drawing into a 3D model, keeping every wobbly line that makes it theirs.

steps.title: We print and finish it
steps.text: The model is printed and then carefully sanded and finished by hand.

steps.title: We paint it by hand
steps.text: Each piece is hand-painted to match the colours of the original drawing.

steps.title: Your keepsake arrives
steps.text: We pack it with care and deliver it to you.

howItWorks.timing: Making a keepsake takes about 3 weeks.

about.title: About Mafan Studio
paragraphs: Mafan Studio is a small creative studio in Hoorn, the Netherlands. We take children's drawings and turn them into real objects you can hold.
Every piece is made one at a time: shaped in 3D, printed, then finished and painted by hand.
We don't "improve" the drawing. The charm is in the details only your child would draw, so we keep them.

instagram.title: Fresh from our studio
instagram.postAlt: A Mafan Studio keepsake on Instagram

items.question: What kind of drawings work?
items.answer: Almost any! Animals, people, monsters, made-up creatures. A clear photo of the drawing is all we need. If something is unclear, we'll ask.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: About 3 weeks from the moment we agree on your keepsake.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every piece is unique, so we give you a personal price once we've seen the drawing. Sending it to us is free and without obligation.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: Anywhere in the Netherlands. Living elsewhere in the EU? Ask us and we'll see what's possible.

items.question: Can you add my child's name?
items.answer: Yes. Just tell us the name you'd like under the statue.
